# netbox_circuit_provider_network (Resource)

From the [offical documentation](https://netboxlabs.com/docs/netbox/models/circuits/providernetwork/):

> This model can be used to represent the boundary of a provider network, the details of which are unknown or unimportant to the NetBox user. For example, it might represent a provider's regional MPLS network to which multiple circuits provide connectivity.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_circuit_provider" "providera" {
    name        = "ProviderA"
    slug        = "providera"
}

resource "netbox_circuit_provider_network" "networka" {
    name        = "NetworkA"
    provider_id = netbox_circuit_provider.providera.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the circuit provider network.
- `provider_id` (Number) The ID of the provider associated with the circuit provider network.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the circuit provider network.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the circuit provider network.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the circuit provider network.
- `service_id` (String) The ID of the service associated with the circuit provider network.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_circuit_provider_network.example 1
```
